claims: The Artemis program is led by NASA.
NASA collaborates with ESA, JAXA, and CSA on the Artemis program.
Boeing builds the SLS core stage.
Lockheed Martin builds the Orion crew capsule.
United Launch Alliance builds the upper stage.
Airbus builds the European Service Module.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Rocket is built by Boeing for the core stage.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Rocket is built by Northrop Grumman for the solid rocket boosters.
The Space Launch System (SLS) Rocket is built by United Launch Alliance for the upper stage.
The Orion Spacecraft is built by prime contractor Lockheed Martin.
Airbus supplies the European Service Module (ESM) for the Orion Spacecraft.
SpaceX develops the Starship for the Human Landing System (HLS).
Blue Origin develops the Blue Moon for the Human Landing System (HLS).
The European Space Agency (ESA), Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) are major contributors to the Artemis program.
The Artemis program officially began in 2017.
The Artemis program aims to return humans to the Moon.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
